name: Sensi Pro: Sensitivity & HUD
summary: Find, test and share your sensitivity, plus a live game HUD and on-device AI.
description:
Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play
• Suggests starting values and prints every rule it used next to the numbers
Values are a guide you type into your game's own menu. The app never touches a game.

TEST & CALIBRATE
• Three short drills inside the app: flick, track a moving ring, micro-adjust
• Measures overshooting, steadiness and precision, turns them into small per-row adjustments and counts your touch rate
• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES
• One profile free, three with VIP; every change is saved automatically
• Templates that mirror each game's menu layout: Free Fire-style, PUBG / BGMI-style, COD Mobile-style and a generic shooter layout
• Share a profile as a code or QR code and import a friend's, offline, no account
• VIP: a converter to another template or screen size, and a profile bound to each game

GAME HUD
A floating panel over the games you open from Sensi Pro, with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges with their thresholds
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, jitter and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus, keep awake, dim, screenshot, plus network, thermal status, battery and free RAM
• GAMES: your games one tap away
Outside a game it shrinks to a ping bubble. Hold it still or tap ✕ for the command wheel (finish the session, hide until your next game, switch off), or drag it to the bottom and drop it on a command. Each command has a 3-second undo.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: games from your list bring up the HUD however you start them, and it keeps each game's spot. Needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front. Without VIP, start games from Sensi Pro, its widget or a home-screen shortcut (3 free tries of Auto HUD)
• Auto setup for games started from Sensi Pro: Focus, keep screen on and dim, undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game

PRE-GAME
• Device Scan: one tap measures ping, jitter, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate. It changes no setting
• Focus Mode: Do Not Disturb for the match, lifted when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• Network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate your next ping
• AI Game Coach: add your games, start them from Sensi Pro and see sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips per game. Free plan: one game at a time; VIP: every game
Both run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested from your phone's RAM, cores and refresh rates, for you to set in the game
• Home-screen widget and a shortcut per game: one tap starts the game with the HUD
• Session report, weekly play time, break reminder
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

VIP (optional subscription)
New features first, Auto HUD, AI Game Coach for unlimited games, auto setup, AI alerts, the converter, profiles 2 and 3, screen recording from the HUD and the VIP mailbox to the Sensi team. Prices are shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Template names only describe each game's own menu layout; game names are trademarks of their owners and this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game. Some games have their own rules about on-screen overlays; check the rules of the game you play.

summary: Game Mode, FPS overlay, match reports and Game Tuner for the games you play
description:
Gamers GLTool Pro is a toolkit for the games you play. Game Mode sets your phone up for each game and puts everything back when you leave. The FPS overlay counts the frames your screen really showed. Every match ends with a report that tells you why it lagged.

No magic buttons: every number in the app is measured on your phone, and nothing in it promises more frames or a lower ping than your phone and your connection can give.

GAME MODE
• A profile per game: do not disturb, the refresh rate held at its highest, a brightness lock, Private DNS and more, switched on when the game starts.
• Everything goes back when you leave, even if the app was closed mid-match. "Revert everything" undoes every change the app ever made.
• A match report after every session: average FPS, 1% lows, a frame time graph, how warm the phone got, battery used and ping, and a plain answer to "why did it lag?".
• Playtime per game over the last seven days.
• A side panel during the game: swipe in from the edge for quick switches, a screenshot, and a memory bar that closes apps running in the background. A Quick Settings tile starts a session without opening the app.

GAME TUNER (BUILT IN)
Resolution, frame cap, refresh rate, clocks, memory and Battery Saver for each game. Sensei, the app's assistant, suggests a level from your phone and your matches; every switch stays yours.

EXTENSIONS (downloaded only when you want them, so the app stays small)
• FPS & performance overlay: the real frame rate, with CPU clock, battery power, temperature and ping. Pick the shape, colour, size and corner.
• Benchmark: capture a match and compare it with an earlier one: average FPS, 1% and 0.1% lows, stutters, heat and battery. A load test shows how much your phone slows down as it warms up.
• Screen recorder: up to 120 FPS where your phone can encode it, with the game's sound, and your voice and a facecam if you want them. Instant replay saves the last 15, 30 or 60 seconds after the moment happened.
• Best settings: find setups shared from the same phone or chip, with real match numbers behind the Verified ones, and share yours to the cloud, as a file or as a code.
• Controls and sensitivity: sensitivity and layout codes for games that share them as codes, with your own kept alongside. The hand check measures your grip, reach and swipe, and suggests a button layout and a camera sensitivity.
• Game sound: a five-band equaliser on the game's sound while you play, with Footsteps, Voices and Less boom presets. It changes what you hear, nothing in the game.
• Network and ping: ping, jitter and loss to game regions and DNS providers, and what your Wi-Fi band and signal are doing.
• Game settings backup: keeps your setup and your games' settings, and puts them back after a reinstall or on a new phone.
• Color boost: your display's most vivid colour mode during games, put back afterwards.

EDITIONS
17 themes for the whole app, each with its own colour, artwork and start-up sound. Make your own and pass it on as a file. And a card of your phone to share.

ADVANCED ACCESS (OPTIONAL)
Reading a game's frame rate and changing settings like the refresh rate need more access than an app has. Give it through wireless debugging (built into the app, Android 11 and newer), Shizuku, or root, or don't: everything else works without it.

PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Profiles, match reports and recordings stay on your phone until you share them yourself. Best settings is the one part that talks to our server: a setup goes up only when you share it, with the nickname you typed and your phone model. The microphone opens only while a recording you started runs with your voice switched on, and the camera only for the facecam.

Gamers GLTool Pro is not affiliated with any game or game publisher.

🧠 BUILT FOR

• Anyone doing a digital detox or trying to cut phone/social media addiction

  time doing

Download MINIMAA and start your digital detox today.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

description:
Organic Maps is a fast, detailed offline map and GPS navigation app for travel, hiking, trekking, and cycling adventures. Plan, import, and record routes, and enjoy smooth guidance without draining your battery or using an internet connection. Explore places and navigate safely during your outdoor adventures and travels around the world. The app offers unlimited map downloads and biweekly updates. OpenStreetMap-based, volunteer-made, privacy-first, 100% offline, and 100% free.

OFFLINE: The app works 100% offline — including search and navigation. You can explore the map and navigate without an internet connection, saving on mobile data and roaming fees. And with no background data transfers, your battery lasts much longer.

FAST: Zooming, search, and route calculations work noticeably fast.

DETAILED & UPDATED: The maps are rich in detail and refreshed twice a month to reflect real-world conditions. Unlike many well-known competitors, they include building labels, benches, hiking paths, and other helpful information.

OPENSTREETMAP-BASED: OpenStreetMap is a wiki-style world map built and maintained by millions of volunteers — locals who know their areas best. This community effort results in highly detailed maps, often more accurate than commercial ones in less-mapped regions. Organic Maps updates its data from OpenStreetMap every two weeks, keeping your maps fresh and reliable. And if you notice something missing, you can add it to OpenStreetMap and help improve the map for everyone.

PRIVACY-FIRST: We don’t collect any data or identifiers. This means there’s no risk of data leaks and no distractions like ads or noisy notifications — just a clean, private map experience.

IMPORTANT FEATURES

EXPLORE PLACES: Search by address, name, or category, discover millions of POIs, and view detailed information such as opening hours, Wikipedia articles, wheelchair accessibility, and other helpful details.

GPS NAVIGATION: Enjoy voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions. Create walking, hiking, cycling, or driving routes — including routes between cities, countries, and multiple waypoints. Find the best routes for your metro journeys and commutes. Android Auto is supported.

HIKING & CYCLING TRAILS FROM AROUND THE WORLD: Enable special map layers to discover popular hiking and cycling routes worldwide, all sourced from OpenStreetMap. Switch between layers to see colored bike and MTB routes, as well as official hiking paths.

PUBLIC TRANSPORT: See public transport route numbers at stops. Live transport schedules and routing are currently in development.

MAP STYLES: Choose map layers that fit your activity — Outdoors, Contour Lines, Hiking, Cycling, or Metro/Subway.

TRACK RECORDER: Record, import, export, and share your routes and favorite places. Supports KML, KMZ, GPX, and GeoJSON formats.

WIKIPEDIA ARTICLES: Explore Wikipedia articles for places you discover on the map. Type “?wiki” in the search to find all places with Wikipedia articles.

MAP EDITOR: Contribute to OpenStreetMap by adding missing places or editing the map directly from Organic Maps.

DARK MODE: Switch to a dark theme for comfortable viewing at night.

Try the app — it’s 100% free, ad-free, fast, and fully offline. Experience reliable GPS navigation for hiking, biking, trekking, and travel anywhere in the world! Enjoy a fast, reliable, and private map experience, and share it with others!

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

- Acompanhamento da temperatura corporal basal e do muco cervical

description:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.
Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
💡 Simple Rules, Deep Strategy
The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

summary: Words fall from the top and you type them before they hit the bottom.
description: Words fall from the top and you type them before they hit the bottom. Clear one and it's a point. Let one land and a life's gone, three total. It sounds easy until two words are falling at once and your brain is spelling "rhythm" while remembering where the keys are. Words get longer, the fall gets faster, and your typing gets sloppier in a way that's entirely your fault. There's a funny focus to it — you stop reading and start just knowing the letters. Good runs feel like the keyboard is part of your hand. Bad ones end with a word you know how to spell sitting at the bottom, judging you.

Sharpen your spatial awareness, train your hand-eye coordination, and improve multi-step problem-solving skills. As you progress through the game, you will encounter unique ring structures including challenging D-rings, S-flex locks, triangular frames, and U-shaped tubes that will truly test your tactical wits. It is a fantastic, wholesome brain workout that helps you stay focused and clear-headed.

💡 Exciting Game Features
• Satisfying Unlock Physics: Feel the smooth tactile feedback as you spin rings, open gaps, and watch complex structures beautifully untangle.
• Varied Ring Mechanics: Master diverse obstacles — rotate C-locks, navigate restricted D-rings, and solve multi-layered circle challenges.
• Hundreds of Smart Levels: Enjoy smooth difficulty progression with hundreds of handcrafted 3D unlock puzzle stages that get progressively more intriguing.
• Helpful Boosters & Hints: Stuck on a complex loop or a particularly difficult ring? Use smart hints and useful tools to untangle tricky rings and keep moving forward.
• Relaxing & Stress-Relieving: Clean visuals, smooth rotation animations, and calming ambient sound effects create a soothing, tranquil atmosphere to help you destress.
• Play Offline Anytime: No Wi-Fi required! Enjoy your daily brain workout anywhere, anytime at your own pace with absolutely no time limits.

🏆 Why You'll Love Rotate Rings
Whether you want to unwind during your daily downtime or flex your brain with intricate spatial logic, Rotate Rings offers the ultimate ring removal and circle unlock challenge. Experience the soothing joy of turning chaotic interlocked shapes into perfectly solved puzzles! Discover a brilliant gameplay loop that is easy to pick up but beautifully challenging to master.

name: UH999 game
summary: Hold the damp needle; release when it meets the bright tick.
description: A damp hair needle swings across a ring of moss ticks. Hold to watch its settle; release to freeze where it stands. Closer to the bright tick keeps the gauge calm; wider landings count as large errors. Three wide drifts end the run. Spamming the release kicks the needle harder and makes the next settle less kind. Between ticks the moss stays quiet, so patience is part of the tool. Precision marks remain on this device. Set the needle down and the damp hair rests until you lift it again.

name: Amaze GO!™

- A wrong tap costs a heart for the level
- Clear the board to finish the level and aim for a perfect run
- Hints help focus when the grid feels tight
  
Why love this arrow puzzle
· Simple rules, profound strategy, and a meditative arrow puzzle
· Short breaks ease stress and sharpen focus
· The last arrow leaves the board with a satisfying mental reset
· Cognitive workout for sequencing and brain teasers
· Quiet visuals, plus a satisfying whoosh as each arrow flies off the grid — feedback that soothes instead of nags

Made for the in-between moments
- The ten minutes before a meeting starts 
- The metro ride too short for a podcast 
- The flight where your signal drops
- The wind-down after a noisy workday 
  
Amaze GO! - Puzzle Games is a calm arrow puzzle made for sharp minds and calm moments. Learn fast, then master timing and order. Send every arrow off the board, untangle the grid, and feel disorder turn into clarity. Amaze GO! is the puzzle you reach for when the rest of the day was too loud — one good move, then another, then a quiet board. Download now, plan smart paths, keep hearts safe, and enjoy pure focus anytime, anywhere!

name: Castle Busters
summary: 1v1 PvP strategy brawler! Build your crew, smash castles and rule the arena!
description:
Castle Busters is a PvP battle game where you build your castle, draft your units, and smash your opponent's castle to pieces. Blast through destructible walls and leave their plans in rubble!

Crush other players in fast 1v1 online multiplayer battles where turn-based strategy meets castle-smashing chaos.

Just you, your rival, and two castles that won't both survive the match intact. And you'd only just finished decorating!

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.

In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart one shot at a time. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes a rival. Who needs a front door anyway?

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Smash through walls and bring down their towers. 

⚡ Turn-based 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions. Make every shot count because your rival gets the next one.

🏗️ Your castle. Your design. Build a castle worth showing off, then put it to the test against other players. Building yours is almost as satisfying as watching theirs collapse. 

🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft your units: brave knights, sharp-eyed archers and bombers who brought more than enough explosives. Combine their strengths, find powerful synergies, and leave your opponent shaking more than their towers.

📈 Upgrades that make a difference. Level up your units and strengthen your castle with new gadgets. Give your crew a stronger home and your opponent a harder job.

🏆 Battle through the arenas. Earn trophies, progress along Trophy Road, and unlock Ranked mode. Battle real players and climb the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

🎯 Play your way. Pick off exposed units with precision or lay siege to their castle. Change your strategy as the walls come down and decide where the next shot will hurt most.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target. Destroy their defenses to open up your next shot, expose their units, and make their castle collapse. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

Win by wiping out all enemy units or turning their castle into rubble. Every turn brings a choice: take out a hero or give their castle a window they didn't ask for.

DRAFT YOUR CREW

Some heroes bring the damage. Others rally the crew to hit even harder. And some bring teammates back from the dead because nobody said they could leave yet.

Mix and match units to build a loadout where their abilities work together. Plan around your favorites, experiment with different combinations, and find a crew that suits your playstyle.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your units, unlock new heroes, and discover fresh tactical options as your crew grows. Your castle evolves too. Strengthen your walls and towers, try new gadgets and strategies, and put your build to the test in multiplayer PvP.

Progress through the arenas on Trophy Road, then climb the ranked ladder and clash with the best. You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

WHO IT'S FOR

If you love turn-based strategy games, 1v1 PvP duels, or fast online multiplayer battles, Castle Busters is built for you. Got a few minutes? That's plenty of time to make a mess of someone's castle. With physics-based artillery and walls that won't stay where you left them, it's impossible to play the same way twice.

The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY

name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
summary: Millions of crafters have smashed billions of blocks! Now you can join the fun!
description:
Dive into an open world of block building, crafting, and survival in the ultimate sandbox adventure. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, new and old. Build a city, start a farm, mine deep underground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination in this expansive simulation!

Craft a new house, build cities, or start a farm. Bring your imagination to life and build your dream world where the possibilities are endless. Adventure through your own online game and play with friends, block building from the ground up in our crafting simulation. In Creative mode, enjoy unlimited resources and the freedom of superior block building and crafting. In Survival mode, survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in your world. JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

name: Oxide: Survival Island
summary: Multiplayer survival simulator on abandoned island: survival action with friends
description:
Oxide: Survival Island is a hard online survival simulator. It is a sandbox world with real players. You wake up on a dangerous shore with nothing. This is island survival. Cold, hunger, animals, and enemies can kill you fast. Every server is a shared world. It keeps running even when you leave.

Play on your own servers. Your progress is saved. You can return later and continue. One server can host many players. That makes the world feel alive. You will meet builders, raiders, and clans. You can fight them or work with them. This is a true massively multiplayer survival experience. Many players look for rust survival vibes on mobile. This game gives that tense loop: gather, craft, build, defend, repeat.

Explore a big island of survival. Go through woods and coastal areas. Travel along the ocean and shore. Visit the gas station and enemy bases. Search loot barrels for supplies. The map is larger and more open. It gives you space to hide, scout, and attack. It also gives enemies more places to ambush you. Each run can feel like a lost island story.

You can play solo. You can also play with others. Try multiplayer survival games with friends. Invite them to the same server. Add them to your friends list. See when they are online. This makes teamwork simple. Build together and protect each other. That is co-op survival. If you like coop survival games, you can share roles. One player farms resources. One crafts weapons. One scouts and guards the base. These are coop survival games built by real players. For many fans, it feels like rust survival multiplayer, but designed for phones.

Collect wood, stone, and metal. Craft tools and gear. Craft weapons and ammo. The game has many weapon types. The crafting system is improved. The building system is improved too. Start with a small shelter. Turn it into a strong base. Place walls, doors, and storage. Create a safe area and defend it.

Use the cupboard system to protect your base. Craft a cupboard and place it inside. Put logs in it often. This slows down decay. It also helps you keep control of your home area. Without it, your house will weaken over time.

Survive in three biomes. Some zones are cold. Some are temperate. Some are hot. Craft attire for protection. Clothing helps against damage. It also helps against cold. Watch your food and water. Hunt animals for meat. Cook and store supplies. Manage your inventory and plan long trips.

Travel by land and by sea. The ocean is not only scenery. It is part of the danger and the route. Fans of sea adventure games will enjoy moving along the coast. You can scout bases from the water. You can move loot between points. The sea can also hide enemies. Storms and long routes add pressure. This is where island survival feels the most tense.

Fight for resources. Defend your base. Raid other bases. Make allies if you want. Betrayal is possible too. Each server becomes a contest for control. This is last survival. Only the strongest teams last. Master land survival, learn the map, and get better gear. Build smart, craft fast, and stay alert.

If you search for rust mobile, you want a tough survival sandbox on your phone. If you search for rust in mobile, you want raids, bases, and real players. Oxide brings that style with persistent servers, crafting, and open-world fights. It is a mobile answer for rust survival, with the freedom of a sandbox and the pressure of multiplayer survival.

Enjoy improved sky graphics and day-night changes. Watch the horizon, track threats, and survive the island.

summary: Choose the right door. Survive the end.
description:
The world has turned to ash, dominated by zombies. Z Route—it is your final path to redemption, and the last battleground of the apocalypse. With nowhere to hide, you can only advance, weapon ready! Redemption or doom? The choice is in your hands!​​
​Crash through every gate of choice and tear through the horde amid roaring engines. Only speed and ruthlessness will keep you alive. Are you ready? This is your war.

​- Trust Your Alliance​
In an apocalypse, no one survives alone. Recruit warriors with different specialties and build the ultimate squad. Strategy and teamwork are your only path to survival.

Every gate is a gamble between life and death. Choose right, and you'll find supplies. Choose wrong, and face the horde. Time is short, so you must decide fast. ​Only the smartest and toughest will achieve redemption!​​

name: Rise of Kingdoms: Lost Crusade
summary: The journey of your civilization starts here.
description:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.

▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!

Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.

Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.

Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!

Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.

Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.

Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!

RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.

Dragon City is the ultimate mobile game where players build a magical floating city, collect and breed over 2,000 unique dragons, and battle other Dragon Masters in action-packed, real-time PvP combat!

It is one of the most popular fantasy dragon games on mobile, seamlessly combining city-building, creature collection, deep strategic combat, and engaging social alliance gameplay. ▶ BUILD A CITY IN THE DRAGONVERSE
Design, expand, and rule your own floating Dragon City across magical islands:

Dragon City features one of the largest and most diverse monster rosters in any mobile game:

• Discover over 2,000 spectacular dragons, from common breeds to rare Mythicals and Legendaries.
• Welcome new legendary dragons every week through live events, battle passes, and special adventure islands.
• Feed and evolve your dragons, transforming them from cute baby hatchlings into legendary beasts.

▶ STRATEGIZE & CONQUER: REAL-TIME PVP COMBAT
Dragon City is built for competitive players who love deeply strategic monster battle gameplay:
• Fight other Dragon Masters in real-time PvP Arenas with customized teams.

name: Narco Empire
summary: From the streets to the throne. Build your own empire.
description:
Free to download and play, with optional in-game purchases, including random items.

Claw your way out of the gutter and seize control of the underworld. Step into a gritty, cinematic world of secret hideouts, high-risk shipments, and bloody turf wars. Every choice you make about trust, risk, and ambition turns you from a nobody into a feared kingpin.

From Corner Deals To The Throne

You start with nothing but nerve. Run small deals, trade favors, and turn every win into power. Block by block, the city bends to your name. But every move you make creates new enemies, and the higher you climb, the harder they hit. How far will you go?

Grow Your Underground Business

Scour dangerous neighborhoods for rare resources and turn a hidden backroom hustle into a full-blown operation. Get hands-on, upgrade your gear, and drive up your profits. Sharpen your methods, hire people you can trust, and scale from a single workbench to a sprawling compound.

Pull Off High-Stakes Smuggling

Pick your routes, load up your convoy, and think fast when things go wrong. Run armed shipments through enemy turf. Slip by quiet or roll in heavy. Buy off the right cops, hit rival gangs where it hurts, and never trust a checkpoint. Each run grows your empire.

Turn Cash Into Power

Build your crew. Run the streets, ink wholesale deals worth millions, and launder every dirty dollar through legit fronts. Pressure your rivals into submission or shake hands with them. Spread your investments wide and keep your empire in the shadows.

Keep the Crown & Stay Alive

Power attracts betrayal. One mistake turns everything to ash. Recruit loyal underbosses, sharpen your enforcers, and root out the snitch before he moves on you. Talk, threaten, or pull the trigger. Loyalty flips overnight. Rule the underworld, or rot in a case file with the rest.

Disclaimer: This game is a work of fiction. All items, events, and characters depicted are entirely fictional and intended for entertainment purposes only. Intended for mature audiences.

name: Colony Flow!
summary: Lead ants, sort colorful cubes, and unlock beautiful pixel art puzzles!
description:
🐜 Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

🧠 COMMAND YOUR COLONY

👆 Tap a box to send its ants marching
🧱 Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
🕳️ Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
🔓 Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
✅ Clear every block to finish the puzzle

🎯 EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

👆 One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
🧩 Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
⏳ No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
🐜 Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
🖼️ Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

🎨 DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals 🐘, fruit 🍓, food 🍜, flowers 🌸, nature 🌿, festivals 🎉, toys 🧸, rockets 🚀, castles 🏰, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

☕ With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

🐜 Tap the right boxes, guide your ants, clear the blocks, and uncover beautiful pixel art. Your colony is waiting!

name: Just Desserts: Revenge & Merge
summary: Merge your way to sweet revenge.
description:
Step into the enchanting town of Frostvale, where sweetness masks dark secrets! Join talented pastry chef Ella as she returns to her hometown to uncover the truth behind a mysterious fire. Merge desserts to restore your family’s beloved pastry shop and dig past the icing to reveal long-buried truths.

Make Desserts

Rebuild the Pastry Shop

Transform your family’s charred shop into a magnificent dream space! Choose vintage tiles, glowing neon signs, and exquisite furniture to design a shop that reflects your style. Each area you rebuild unveils new plot clues.

Reconnect with the Past

Reunite with Edward, your former lover. Is he your unexpected savior or an accomplice to the arson? As rivals appear, what schemes lie behind their charming smiles? Explore your mother’s mysterious recipe and the secrets of that fateful night!

Uncover the Truth

name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

name: Top Eleven Be a Soccer Manager

Top Eleven features an advanced 3D live match engine and real-time PVP matchmaking, allowing you to experience soccer excitement like never before. You will be able to sign a team of superstar soccer players, plan training sessions, build your soccer campus, and create soccer management strategies that will lead your team to trophies across different competitions in every Top Eleven season. It's your club - and your rules! 
 
 Top Eleven 2027 powers into another year of action with more tactical depth than ever before! Dominate the touchline with brand-new tactical controls, advanced data visualizations, and deep statistical reports designed to elevate your management strategy. 
 
 Top Eleven 2027 makes it easy to lead your dream squad: 
 
 START YOUR CAREER AS A SOCCER MANAGER
 -Jump into real-time Auctions and compete with other managers to sign the best soccer players for your top 11.
 - Pick and choose tactical training drills to have your squad ready and prepped for the big matchday fixtures.
 - Set the formations that will deliver wins in daily 3D soccer games.
 - Collect exclusive jerseys and emblems and show off your soccer club's unique style.
 
 TRAIN YOUR PLAYERS AND DEVELOP MATCH TACTICS
 -Boost player’s attributes trough Attack, Defense, Possession, and Physical&Mental drills 
 -Improve Team Form faster with Starter, Expert or Ultimate Team Play Drills
 - Create unique counter-strategies for every individual fixture to outsmart your opponents.
 
 WIN SOCCER COMPETITIONS AND LIVE EVENTS

name: Age of Spirits
summary: Lead Your Tribe Against the Dark.
description:
Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled around scattered hearth-fires, listening for the whispers of the Old Ones, the ancient wicked gods who hungered for living warmth and dragged the souls of the weak into the underworld. Most clans flickered out before the first dawn. A few endured. And then, the spirits sent a Chief.

You are that Chief, the one whose will guides the people from above the firelight. Though you do not lift the spear yourself, every shaman you awaken bears your command, every villager labors by your decree, and every hearth-fire that burns is kindled because you have decided it should. From the high seat of an isolated tribe at the edge of the dark, you must reclaim wandering savages, summon legendary heroes to lead your warbands, build the first true settlement the Wilds have ever known, and forge a people strong enough to outlive the night.

Age of Spirits is a strategy game of awakening, ritual, and primal resolve. Will you raise tall stones around your hearth-fire and grow your tribe into a city of rites and crafts, or will you march your warbands deep into ancestral grounds to seize what only the bravest can win? The ancestors are watching. The Old Ones are stirring. The spark of all that is to come rests in your hands. Do you have the will to lead the first tribe into a new age?

GAME FEATURES

Awaken Savages, Bestow Wisdom: Bring untamed savages from the deep Wilds to your hearth-fire and awaken them as villagers. Assign your people to every post that matters, gathering, hunting, crafting, and tending the rites. Watching each pair of hands turn raw labor into the resources that grow your tribe.

Lead Expeditions, Claim the Spoils: Command your heroes on expeditions deep into ancestral grounds. Face perilous trials in turn-based combat, defeat champions of the dark, and bring home precious bounties and the rare materials no settlement can rise without.

Summon Legendary Heroes: Summon spirit-touched champions, such as fierce hunters, far-sighted wizards, and bone-clad guardians, to serve as the heroes of your tribe. Promote and equip them with ancestral weapons and ritual gear, then send your strongest to lead every march and stand at the front of every fight.

Build Your Tribe from a Single Fire: Raise your settlement from a circle of stones into a thriving tribe. Kindle the central hearth, consecrate altars of wisdom and faith, sink quarries and woodyards, train new warriors, and upgrade every structure to unlock new units, rites, and strength.

Challenge Across the World Map: March your armies across a vast living world. Lay claim to resource grounds, raid rival tribes, contest sacred lands, defeat field bosses, and write your name on the map in flame and stone.

Join Forces with Alliances: Form alliances with players from across the world. Coordinate strategies, share resources, defend each other's lands, and wage large-scale battles together against rival forces.

SPECIAL NOTES

Can you help Klaus/Karin cope with the heavy inheritance of the German occupation, so they will find their place in a country that is celebrating its freedom?

Polygon: "My Child Lebensborn tells a disturbing tale about innocents in the aftermath of WW2”
LevelUp: “The strongest game experience that I have ever had.”

My Child Lebensborn is a BAFTA-winning parenting simulation with original gameplay and a heartbreaking story. It has challenged millions of players to experience how hard it is to keep a child safe when they are seen as symbols of a hated enemy.

See a different side of the war, inspired by the true stories of the Lebensborn children. Discover how hatred of our enemies continues to create victims, even after victory. Discover their past and support them in the present. You must balance your time and resources to provide for your child. You will find answers to the hard questions; about their history, the hatred, bullying and the passing of blame.

Feed, clothe, teach, and comfort your child as you navigate the prejudices of a hostile community. Every decision shapes who they become.

- Look for the effects of your choices in your child’s expressions and body language.
- Explore a gripping storyline based upon true events.

Parts of the game's proceeds are donated to help protect Children Born of War (children born of enemy soldiers and local women).

- New whips and Summoner prefixes. 
- New Kites, critters, and decorative features. 
- And so much more to discover!

- A new Skyblock world seed.
- A new world creation menu allowing you to mix and match special seeds.
- Improvements to existing seeds!

IMPROVEMENTS:

- Visual updates to many classic sprites.
- And so many more improvements!

• MULTIPLAYER – Play with up to 7 friends on Local Wifi or Online via device-device Wifi hosted games or through the Mobile Terraria Dedicated Server for PC (available for free on Terraria.org)

• Over 20 NPCs to discover, each providing their own benefits and unique style
• More than 1000 new items to discover – bringing the total item count to more than 5000!

name: The Sun Origin Post Apocalypse
summary: Post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG.
description:
Autumn sale: Save 75% on The Sun: Origin!

The Sun: Origin is a post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG that will challenge you to survive in a harsh and unforgiving world. Explore the wastelands, build your character, and fight for your life against mutants, bandits, and other survivors.

Key Features:

* Explore a vast and dangerous world: The wastelands are full of resources and dangers. Explore every corner of the map to find valuable loot, but be prepared to fight for it.
* Build your character: Choose from a variety of classes and customize your character's skills and abilities. Level up your character and become stronger as you progress through the game.
* Fight for your survival: The wastelands are full of enemies, both human and mutant. Fight for your life against bandits, raiders, and even other survivors.
* Craft your gear: Use the resources you find in the wastelands to craft weapons, armor, and other equipment. Build the best gear you can to survive in this harsh world.

The Sun: Origin is a challenging game, but it is also a rewarding one. If you are up for the challenge, then this game is for you.

Download The Sun: Origin today and experience the post-apocalyptic wasteland for yourself!

name: Five Nights at Freddy's
summary: Keep an eye on the animatronics and you'll make it thru the night... probably.
description:
NOTE: Remastered version from the PC version. A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food as far as the eye can see! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it was much cheaper to hire you as a security guard than to find a repairman.

From your small office you must watch the security cameras carefully. You have a very limited amount of electricity that you're allowed to use per night (corporate budget cuts, you know). That means when you run out of power for the night- no more security doors and no more lights! If something isn't right- namely if Freddybear or his friends aren't in their proper places, you must find them on the monitors and protect yourself if needed!

Can you survive five nights at Freddy's?

NOTE: Interface and audio in English. Subtitles in English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean.

#MadeWithFusion

name: Children of Morta
summary: A story-driven roguelite RPG
description:
*Save up to 80%!*

Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG with a roguelite approach to character development, in which you don’t play a single character but a whole, extraordinary family of heroes. 

Hack’n’slash through hordes of enemies in procedurally generated dungeons, caves and lands and lead the Bergson family, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. The story takes place in a distant land but copes with themes and emotions common to all of us: love and hope, longing and uncertainty, ultimately loss... and sacrifice we are willing to make to save the ones we care the most for. 
Ultimately, it's about a family of heroes standing together against the encroaching darkness.

-- Complete Edition --

Both the Ancient Spirits and the Paws and Claws DLC are included in the main game and available as you play.

FEATURES
- Welcome to the family! Join the heroic Bergsons in their trials to honor their heritage and save the land of Rea from the creeping Corruption 
- One for all, all for one: improve skills and gear for the whole family through each run in the ever-changing world of this roguelite RPG
- Stronger together: switch between 7 playable characters, each with their own abilities, fighting styles and endearing personality 
- Immerse yourself in the beautiful, deadly world of Rea through gorgeous 2D pixel art mixing handcrafted animations with modern lighting techniques
- Family that slays together stays together: use the two-player online coop mode and rely on each other in every fight (available in a post-launch update)

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Google Play Games achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
- Compatible with controllers

name: Geometry Dash
summary: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rythm-based action platformer!
description:
Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!

Prepare for a near impossible challenge in the world of Geometry Dash. Push your skills to the limit as you jump, fly and flip your way through dangerous passages and spiky obstacles.

Simple one touch game play with lots of levels that will keep you entertained for hours!

Game Features

• Rhythm-based Action Platforming!
• Lots of levels with unique soundtracks!
• Build and share your own levels using the level editor!
• Unlock new icons and colors to customize your character!
• Fly rockets, flip gravity and much more!
• Use practice mode to sharpen your skills!
• Lots of achievements and rewards!
• No in-app purchases!
• Challenge yourself with the near impossible!

Contact: support@robtopgames.com

name: My Boy! - GBA Emulator
summary: A fast, full-featured GBA emulator with link cable emulation.
description:
My Boy! is a super fast and full-featured emulator to run GameBoy Advance games on Android devices, from very low-end phones to modern tablets. It emulates nearly all aspects of the real hardware, including linking devices for multiplayer games.

Highlights:
• Super fast emulation, thanks to the JIT recompiler.
• Very high game compatibility. Run nearly all games without a problem.
• Link cable emulation either on the same device, or across devices over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi.
• Gyroscope/tilt/solar sensor and rumble emulation through your Android's hardware sensors and vibrator!
• Enter multilined GameShark/ActionReplay/CodeBreaker cheat codes and enable/disable them on the fly while the game is running.
• High-level BIOS emulation. No BIOS file needed.
• IPS/UPS ROM patching
• OpenGL rendering backend, as well as normal rendering on devices without a GPU.
• Cool video filters through the support of GLSL shaders.
• Fast-forward to skip long stories, as well as slow down games to get past a level you cannot in normal speed.
• Save games at any time with screenshot
• Sync saves with Google Drive. Play and save games on one device and continue on the others!
• On-screen keypad (multi-touch requires Android 2.0 or later), as well as shortcut buttons such as load/save. 
• A screen layout editor, with which you can define the position and size for each of the on-screen controls, as well as for the game video.
• Clean & simple yet well-designed user interface. Seamlessly integrated with the latest Android.
• Create and switch to different screen-layout and key-mapping profiles.
• Create shortcuts to easily launch your favorite games from your desktop.

No games are included in this app and you need to obtain yours in a legal way. Place them onto your device storage and you are good to go.

LEGAL: This product is not affiliated with, nor authorized, endorsed or licensed in any way by Nintendo Corporation, its affiliates or subsidiaries.

name: Reigns
summary: Swipe left, swipe right, be the King.
description:
** Play Store Most Innovative Game of 2016 **

Sit on the throne as a benevolent (or malevolent) medieval monarch of the modern age and swipe your royal fingers either left or right to impose your will upon the kingdom. Survive the seemingly never-ending gauntlet of requests from your advisors, peasants, allies, and enemies while maintaining balance between the influential factions of your kingdom. But beware; each decision you make might have implications and unfortunate consequences down the road that could put your reign and family’s dynasty at risk!

Each year of your reign brings another important – seemingly random – request from your unpredictable kingdom as you strive for balance between the church, the people, the army, and the treasury. Prudent decisions and careful planning make for a long reign but unforeseen motivations, surprise events, and poor luck can take down even the most entrenched monarch. Extend your reign as long as possible, forge alliances, make enemies, and find new ways to die as your dynasty marches along through the ages. Some events will span on centuries, with an intrigue involving burning witches, scientific enlightenment, wicked politics and, maybe, the Devil himself.

name: Wreckfest - Demolition Racing
summary: Break the rules and take full-contact racing to the limit with Wreckfest!
description:
🏁 Wreckfest is jam-packed with upgrade and customization options. Whether you are preparing for your next demolition derby with reinforced bumpers, roll cages, side protectors and much more, or setting your car up for a banger race with engine performance parts like air filters, camshafts, fuel systems, etc., Wreckfest is shaping up to be the best combative motorsport game out there. 💥

• Unique Racing Experience – Exhilarating no-rules racing action with defining, once-in-a-lifetime moments that can be achieved only with a true-to-life physics simulation. Witness insane neck-to-neck fighting on high-speed circuits, face total destruction madness on crazy courses with intersections and oncoming traffic, or go for demolition dominance in derby arenas.

• Awesome Cars – Our cars are old, banged up, patched together... They ooze style and character! From old American heavy-hitters to agile Europeans and fun Asians, you won’t find anything like this in other games. 

• Meaningful Customization – Change not only the look of your cars but also upgrade their body armor – Reinforce them with heavy iron that protects you from damage, but also adds weight, which impacts the cars handling. Modify your car to make a robust tank or a fragile but lightning-fast rocket, or anything in between!

• Multiplayer – Wreck your friends in local multiplayer and take racing to the limit while chasing for demolition dominance!

• Challenge modes – Have hilarious fun with crop harvesters, lawn mowers, school buses, three-wheelers and much more! 

• Career Mode – Battle for championships, earn experience, unlock new upgrades and cars, and become the all-time Wreckfest champion!

© THQ Nordic Mobile 2026

name: Driving Zone: Germany Pro
summary: Driving simulator with German cars. Racing car games without ads and limits.
description:
Driving Zone: Germany Pro – the premium version of the popular car game and street racing simulator, without ads or limitations. Experience the thrill of driving legendary German cars with ultra-realistic physics and graphics.

Pro Version Features:
- 20,000 bonus coins.
- Completely ad-free. Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with no distractions.
- Free driving mode. Your car will never break down, allowing you to enjoy endless driving fun.
- Unified cloud save and progress synchronization with the free version of the game.

Explore a variety of game modes:
- Career Mode: Complete exciting missions like parking challenges, time-based races, overtaking in traffic, and long-distance driving.
- Driving School: Master essential driving skills in a test environment, navigating cones and learning advanced techniques.
- Street Racing: Compete on highways, city streets, or icy winter tracks with dynamic weather changes.
- Drift Mode: Perfect your drifting skills on sharp turns and earn points for style and precision.
- Drag Racing: Compete in high-speed, straight-line races on a 402-meter drag track.
- Replay Mode: Relive your best races and improve your strategy with cinematic replays.

Enhanced Tracks and Features:
The Pro version features many unique tracks, including:
- Bavarian Alps: Drive through challenging mountain roads with breathtaking views.
- Test Track: Learn driving mechanics in a controlled environment.
- Highway and city streets: Enjoy day or night drive on roads with dense traffic.
- Drag Strip: Push your car’s speed to the limit in drag races.

Additional Features:
- High-quality 3D graphics and ultra realistic car physics.
- Prototypes of legendary german cars with customization and tuning options.
- Dynamic day-night cycles and weather changes.
- Multiple camera angles: first-person, interior, cinematic views.
- Automatic cloud save for seamless progress syncing.

Start your engines and embark on the ultimate driving adventure without limits. Customize your car, master challenging tracks, and explore diverse gameplay modes in a premium, distraction-free experience.

Warning! This game is highly realistic, but it is not intended to teach or encourage street racing. Please drive carefully and responsibly in real life. Enjoy virtual driving in dense traffic, but always follow traffic rules and stay safe on real roads.

name: Reporter - Scary Horror Game
summary: Reporter, a survival horror.
description:
Discover heart-thumping terror, chase and scary creatures in this atmospheric horror game. But no matter what, never play alone in the dark.

Is Your mind is hungry for tricky puzzles and nerves are suffering without ticklish situations? This action-horror "Reporter" from "AGaming+" will shake you to the core! Turn off the light and get your earphones! Be attentive, because it’s the only thing that can help you to get out from the paws of horror that is happening here. 

All the story started in a small town. Once on a wonderful day, the town was shocked by series of horrible kills under terrifying and inexplicable circumstances. Police have tried to hide the facts, but some information leaked and was published by local press. Trying to understand what has happened there, you start your search for the truth. But suddenly, you become the part of the story that you'll remember till the end of your life. It all depends on you, will you unravel this plexus of horror and chaos and survive?

Warning: for perfect experience and correct game functioning 1GB of RAM is required.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
summary: No place to run, and exactly one place to hide.
description:
NOTE: Remastered version from the PC version. A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza!

In Five Nights at Freddy's 2, the old and aging animatronics are joined by a new cast of characters. They are kid-friendly, updated with the latest in facial recognition technology, tied into local criminal databases, and promise to put on a safe and entertaining show for kids and grown-ups alike!

What could go wrong?

As the new security guard working nights, your job is to monitor cameras and make sure nothing goes wrong after-hours. The previous guard has complained about the characters trying to get into the office (he has since been moved to day-shift). So to make your job easier, you've been provided with your very own empty Freddy Fazbear head, which should fool the animatronic characters into leaving you alone if they should accidentally enter your office.

As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

NOTE: Interface and audio in English. Subtitles in English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean.

#MadeWithFusion

name: Farming Simulator 23 Mobile
summary: Grow your agricultural empire with 100+ authentic machines!
description:
Grow crops, grow your agricultural empire! Become a modern farmer to operate more than 100 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world - offering a wide range of farming activities. 

Choose what kind of farmer you want to be in Farming Simulator 23 (FS23) as the acclaimed agricultural sim by GIANTS Software offers a brand-new experience with many new features for your mobile device!

Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and more
Cultivate fields with a variety of crops, or harvest grapes and olives on the hillside
Start logging with heavy forestry equipment 
Establish production chains and use powerful trucks for transport
Tend to farm animals like cows, sheep, and now: chickens!
Enjoy tons of possibilities on two new maps, including collectibles
New gameplay features also introduce plowing and weeding
A tutorial mode, AI helper & a new autoload feature for logs/pallets assist you on your farm 

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry - there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. If more than 100 machines are not enough, you can grow your fleet of agricultural vehicles through official extra content.

New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life. Start farming wherever you go and let the good times grow!

Farming Simulator 23 will be released on May 23, 2023, and is the latest official game in the successful simulation series available for mobile devices.

name: Max Payne Mobile
summary: Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for Android mobile devices.
description:
Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for Android mobile devices.

A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Max Payne is a relentless story-driven game about a man on the edge, fighting to clear his name while struggling to uncover the truth about his slain family amongst a myriad of plot-twists. 

The groundbreaking original cinematic action-shooter, Max Payne introduced the concept of Bullet Time® in videogames. Through its stylish slow-motion gunplay combined with a dark and twisted story, Max Payne redefined the action-shooter genre.

Max Payne Mobile for Android has been fully optimized for the NVIDIA® Tegra® 3 quad-core mobile processor with additional antistrophic texture filtering and enhanced lighting effects providing one of the most visually immersive Max Payne Mobile experiences available. 

Features:
• Max Payne's signature slow motion gunplay, Bullet Time® 
• Stunningly sharp, HD quality resolution and textures
• Gameplay tailored for touch screen devices
• Highly customizable controls 
• Multiple aiming modes
• Compatible with the GameStop Wireless Game Controller and select USB gamepads
• Integrated with Immersion Haptic Vibration Feedback
• Tailor your visual experience with adjustable graphic settings 
• Unlock cheats, track your stats and more with full Rockstar Games Social Club integration 

Max Payne Mobile is now available on:
Android Phones: Motorola Razr,  Razr Maxx, Motorola Atrix, Motorola Photon, Motorola Droid Bionic, HTC Rezound, HTC One X,  HTC One S,  HTC Evo 3D, HTC Sensation, HTC Droid Incredible 2,  Samsung Galaxy Nexus, Samsung Nexus S, Samsung Galaxy Note, Samsung S2, Samsung Galaxy R, Sony Xperia Play, Sony Xperia S, Sony Walkman Z Series Media Player

Android Tablets: Acer Iconia, Asus Eee Pad Transformer, Asus Eee Pad Transformer Prime, LG Optimus Pad, Medion Lifetab, Motorola Xoom, Samsung Galaxy Tab 8.9 / 10.1, Sony Tablet S, Sony Tablet P, Toshiba Thrive, HTC Flyer, HTC Jetstream

name: Balatro
summary: When Poker Meets Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro game!

Your goal is to beat Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands. 
Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Take on challenging bosses, discover wild poker hands and unlock new decks as you play. 

You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices; now even more satisfying!
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Aerofly FS Global
summary: Fly around the world with Aerofly FS Global Flight Simulator
description:
Aerofly FS Global is a highly realistic Flight Simulator in PC-quality for your mobile device for beginner and professional flight sim pilots. Explore the world of flying with extremely detailed and accurately simulated airliners, fully interactive 3D cockpits and realistic aircraft systems. Fly with complex airliners, helicopters, business jets, fighter jets and warbirds, general aviation aircraft, aerobatic stuntplanes and gliders across the photorealistic landscape.

name: Legend of Keepers
summary: Become a dungeon master!
description:
Legend of Keepers is a premium game without micro-transactions (but with upcoming big content DLCs!)

Have you ever wanted to become the villain of the story? 
Well, the Dungeons Company is looking for its new Boss and needs you to protect their treasures!

Legend of Keepers is a mix between roguelite and dungeon management, where you play as a dungeon manager hiring monsters and building traps to defeat the heroes coming for your gold. 
You have to experience every company’s struggles in this fantasy workspace simulation, from sick leaves to strikes, and manage your team to run the most impenetrable dungeon! 
In this ""reverse-Darkest Dungeon"", climb the corporate ladder and optimize your strategy to become the most fearsome (and, perhaps, respected) boss in dungeon history! 

* FEATURES *
- Don’t play nice for once: be the bad guy and make those smug heroes pay with your mischievous strategies
- Deal with the trials of corporate life: mix and match your roster of bloodthirsty employees to stay on top of the dungeon business
- Being bad never looked this good: see your enemies perish in drop-dead gorgeous animations. Watch out for stains! 
- Manage your resource budget: On top of morale, gold, blood and tears must be spent wisely is this economy. 
- Diversify your management styles:  Play as 3 dungeon masters - each with their own abilities and recruits - through various campaigns

*NEW MASTERS, NEW ENVIRONMENTS, NEW MONSTERS!*
Unlock the three DLCS : Return Of The Goddess, Feed The Troll and Soul Smugglers. Buy them separately, or together with the DLC Bundle.

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface
- Google Play Games achievements
- Compatible with controllers
- No micro-transactions!

name: Bloons TD 6
summary: Smash Hit Tower Defense Game
description:
Craft your perfect defense from a combination of powerful Monkey Towers and awesome Heroes, then pop every last invading Bloon!

Over a decade of tower defense pedigree and regular massive updates makes Bloons TD 6 a favorite game for millions of players. Enjoy endless hours of strategy gaming with Bloons TD 6!

HUGE CONTENT!
* Regular updates! We release several updates every year with new characters, features, and gameplay.
* Boss Events! Fearsome Boss Bloons will challenge even the strongest defenses.
* Odysseys! Battle through a series of maps connected by their theme, rules, and rewards.
* Contested Territory! Join forces with other players and battle for territory against five other teams. Capture tiles on a shared map and compete on the leaderboards.
* Quests! Delve into what makes the Monkeys tick with Quests, crafted to tell tales and share knowledge.
* Trophy Store! Earn Trophies to unlock dozens of cosmetic items that let you customize your Monkeys, Bloons, animations, music, and more.
* Content Browser! Create your own Challenges and Odysseys, then share them with other players and check out the most liked and played community content.

EPIC MONKEY TOWERS & HEROES!
* 25 powerful Monkey Towers, each with 3 upgrade paths and unique activated abilities.
* Paragons! Explore the incredible power of the newest Paragon upgrades.
* 17 diverse Heroes, with 20 signature upgrades and 2 special abilities. Plus, unlockable skins and voiceovers!

ENDLESS AWESOMENESS!
* 4-Player Co-Op! Play every map and mode with up to 3 other players in public or private games.
* Play anywhere - single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t!
* 70+ handcrafted maps, with more added every update.
* Monkey Knowledge! Over 100 meta-upgrades to add power where you need it.
* Powers and Insta Monkeys! Earned through gameplay, events, and achievements. Instantly add power for tricky maps and modes.

We pack as much content and polish into each update as possible, and we’ll continue to add new features, content, and challenges in regular updates.

We truly respect your time and support, and we hope Bloons TD 6 will be the best strategy game you’ve ever played. If it’s not, please contact us at https://support.ninjakiwi.com and tell us what we can do better!

name: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redu
summary: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux - Post-Apocalyptic Action Shooter
description:
Survive deadly combat and stealth in the poisoned wasteland of Chernobyl Zone. Play as Serioga, lead your people to safety in the old subway tunnels, and fight for survival in this immersive post-apocalyptic world.

Long Description:

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is an epic, story-driven first person post-apocalyptic shooter from AGaming+. In 2014, an apocalypse destroyed most of humanity and turned the Earth's surface into a poisoned wasteland. It's now 2034, and as the surface of the Earth freezes, people must seek shelter in the old subway tunnels.

You play as Serioga, a survivor born just before the apocalypse, who must lead your people to safety and fight for survival against terrifying enemies. Explore the dangerous world, scavenge for resources, and engage in deadly combat and stealth.

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is one of the most immersive game worlds ever created, with stunning graphics and realistic sound effects. Can you survive and lead your people to safety? Play Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux now and find out.

name: Incredibox
summary: Create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers!
description:
Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy swing, Brazilian rhythms and much more. As well, discover a selection of mods created by the community. Plenty to keep you mixing for hours, with no ads or microtransactions.

Part game, part tool, Incredibox is above all an audio and visual experience that has quickly become a hit with people of all ages. The right mix of music, graphics, animation and interactivity makes Incredibox ideal for everyone. And because it makes learning fun and entertaining, Incredibox is now being used by schools all over the world.

How to play? Easy! Drag and drop icons onto the avatars to make them sing and start to compose your own music. Find the right sound combos to unlock animated choruses that will enhance your tune.

Once your composition sounds great, just save it and share it to get as many votes as possible. If you get enough votes, you may go down in Incredibox history by joining the Top 50 chart! Ready to show your stuff?

You can also download your mix as an MP3 from the app and listen to it over and over again!

Too lazy to create your own mix? No problem, just let the automatic mode play for you!

Pump it up and chill ;)

****************
Incredibox, the brainchild of Lyon, France-based studio So Far So Good, was created in 2009. Starting out as a webpage, it was then released as a mobile and tablet app and became an instant hit. It has won several awards and appeared in various international media, including: BBC, Adobe, FWA, Gizmodo, Slate, Konbini, Softonic, Kotaku, Cosmopolitan, PocketGamer, AppAdvice, AppSpy, Vice, Ultralinx and many others. The online demo has attracted more than 100 million visitors since its creation.

summary: Welcome to the ultimate FNaF mashup!

NOTE: A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.
